verdict.rationale: Drafting follow-up emails is a fair capability to expect from an AI meeting assistant. The evidence pack documents AI summaries, action items, custom summaries and a conversational assistant, but nothing describes Fathom drafting a follow-up email for review and quick sending. Summaries and action items are adjacent features and do not count as email drafting.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks
